newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil police arrests Italian murder suspect.
newsitem.headline: Brazil police arrests Italian murder suspect.

text.p: Brazilian police arrested an Italian wanted in Italy on murder charges on Wednesday and he is awaiting extradition, a police spokesman said.

Federal police arrested Raffaele Errante, 47, in Rio de Janeiro's Copacabana beachfront neighbourhood in response to an extradition request by Italy, where he is wanted in connection with the 1994 murder of his brother Francesco Errante.
Errante is from the southern Italian city of Reggio Calabria.
